messages:
Noah Rivera: Hey all  just joined today (Noah, AE). Quick blocker: I don’t have HubSpot or Gong access and I can’t open the AE Kickoff doc in Drive. Who should I tag for seats and where’s the current quick-start checklist?

IT Ops: Welcome Noah! Please paste the provisioning snippet into the IT portal or use the quick form. Example to paste:
```
product: Sales apps
requester: Noah Rivera
email: noah.rivera@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (full), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Kickoff
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-07-15
```
Reply with the ticket ID once submitted and I’ll follow up.

Noah Rivera: Filed as REQ-5348. Thx. Also who owns the discovery playbook and any short cheat-sheets?

Jules (enablement): Hey Noah  I maintain the AE Playbooks. Canonical location: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Kickoff-2024. Start with "Discovery 10-min cheat" and "Qualification checklist". I’ll share a copy in Drive and add you to the folder.

Ravi (AE lead): Welcome! Quick FYI: we use Gong tags: discovery, demo, pricing. Enable auto-tagging once you’re in. Also we have a short "3 common objections" one-pager that lives in Collateral -> Objections. I’ll schedule a 30-min sync Wednesday 3pm for shadow sign-up.

Noah Rivera: REQ-5348 says "provisioning in progress". @IT Ops any ETA?

IT Ops: Should be done within 2-3 hours. If SSO mapping fails we’ll send direct invites. I’ll update REQ-5348 with invite links.

onboarding-bot: Hi Noah Rivera! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/noah_rivera_1743456789. Tasks: Accept HubSpot invite, Watch Gong intro (12m), Shadow x2, Log first activity in CRM.

Jules (enablement): Also quick templates for outbound cadences are in HubSpot under Sequences -> shared/AE-templates. Ping me if you want me to clone one into your owned folder.

Noah Rivera: Got it. One more Q: where do I find the vertical pitch decks (SaaS/FinServ)?

Ravi (AE lead): /Sales/Collateral/By-Vertical. Use the "SaaS one-pager" for initial calls, save the FinServ deck for qualified demos. If you want, I’ll drop the top-3 slides in a Slack DM for quick reference.

IT Ops: REQ-5348 updated: HubSpot seat granted, Gong invite sent via SSO. Check your email and accept. If you see a 403 or 404, reply with a screenshot here.

Noah Rivera: Accepted both invites and can access the playbook. Logged into Gong and watched the intro. Thanks everyone  see you Wednesday for the sync. :tada:
